summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Haleon plc, a UK foreign private issuer, reporting open-market share repurchases for cancellation under its existing buyback programme. The filing details purchases on 22–26 June 2026 of 6,992,435 ordinary shares at an average price around 332 pence per share. There is no offer, tender, premium, or special event beyond normal buyback execution. The filing is a periodic transaction report, not a special-situation announcement. As a standard buyback disclosure, it does not require classification as a special situation.
